title: Counties, Rivers & Cities - Megyék, folyók és városok

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say that Hungary has 19 counties (megyék) and that Budapest is the capital.
I can name the Danube and the Tisza and say what the Dunántúl and the Alföld are like.
I can say where Lake Balaton is and what lies on its northern shore.
I can say which region key cities such as Debrecen and Pécs are in.
I can use mentén and között in simple geographical descriptions.
